richiami.difetto: Water may enter the starter motor and cause damage. As a result, the engine may no longer start, or the starter motor may short-circuit or remain continuously activated. This could cause local overheating of the starter motor or thermal overload of surrounding components and lead to a vehicle fire, including when the ignition is switched off. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 31/08/2026
richiami.titolo: Water may enter the starter motor and cause damage.

traduzione.difetto: L'acqua può entrare nel motore avviatore e provocare danni. Di conseguenza, il motore potrebbe non avviarsi più, oppure il motore avviatore potrebbe cortocircuitare o rimanere attivo continuamente. Ciò potrebbe causare surriscaldamento locale del motore avviatore o sovraccarico termico dei componenti circostanti e portare a un incendio del veicolo, anche quando la chiave è stata spostata in posizione spenta. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla omologazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

richiami.difetto: The RSW22 starter with reinforced water tightness (RWT) may experience increased abrasion of the magnetic contact, causing deposits to build up at the lowest point inside the relay. These deposits may increase relay contact resistance, leading to starting failures or short circuits. If a short circuit occurs, either when attempting to start the vehicle or while driving due to vibration-related movement of the deposits, it could cause a thermal event and increase the risk of fire. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

richiami.difetto: The safety recall relates to a PVC seam seal defect which may have occurred in the body area of the right real light housing. It is possible that seam sealant was not applied to a panel overlap area this may result in water ingress into the vehicle in the area of the right rear light. If water does enter the trunk in the area of the right rear light it may result in water ingress onto the exposed power distribution box as well as adjacent wiring harnesses and electrical components. It cannot be reliably excluded that electrical contacts may be affected particularly due to capillary effects. In this case moisture ingress and the resulting long-term corrosion may lead to increased contact resistance as well as functional degradation or failure of individual electrical components. Over the service life a thermal event cannot be completely ruled out.
richiami.rimedio: On the affected vehicles the PVC seam will be checked and if necessary reworked.
richiami.titolo: Reworking the PVC Seam in the Rear Light Housing

richiami.difetto: BMW has decided to initiate the safety recall “Curtain Airbag” with regard to the BMW model NA5. On affected vehicles both curtain airbags (left and right) may not have been properly screwed according to specification. If the curtain airbag is not installed properly it cannot be ruled out that noises (rattling) may occur while driving. Furthermore if the airbag  deploys this may result in altered deployment characteristics and the inflator generator may become separated. This could increase the risk of injury.
richiami.rimedio: On affected vehicles the screw connection of the curtain airbags (left and right) will be checked and reworked if necessary.
richiami.titolo: Check the Head Airbag Threaded Connection; Rework if Necessary

richiami.difetto: BMW has decided to initiate the safety recall “Replace the Onboard  Charger” with regards to the certain BMW NA5 models.  On affected vehicles the onboard charger will be replaced. If there is a  reduced insulation there is an extremely low risk of a dangerous  voltage on the vehicle chassis. The fault is not detectable by the  customer.
richiami.rimedio: On affected vehicles the onboard charger will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: Replacing the Convenience Charging Electronics

richiami.difetto: The Safety Recall relates to the air-conditioning wiring harness located  behind the dashboard. On the affected vehicles the wiring harness was  fixed very close to a screw connection on the interior microfilter housing  cover. The microfilter of the air conditioning system will be regularly  replaced as part of the oil service. It cannot be ruled out that cables may  be damaged when replacing the microfilter during a workshop visit. The  filter cover has to be removed from the lower part of the instrument  panel. After replacing the filter the cover has to be refitted at which  point the wires may become damaged or trapped. If the wiring harness is  damaged this could lead to malfunctions of the air conditioning system as  well as to a short circuit. In case of a short circuit a sensor may overheat  while the vehicle is in operation. As a result smoke may develop from the  instrument panel and subsequently a fire cannot be ruled out.
richiami.rimedio: On the affected vehicles the air-conditioning wiring harness will be  checked repaired if necessary and re-secured in a modified fixing.
richiami.titolo: Checking and re-securing the air-conditioning wiring harness

richiami.difetto: The Safety Recall relates to the engine starter motor. The fault relates to  the RSW22 starter RWT (reinforced water tightness). It was found that  with RWT starters an increased abrasion of the magnetic contact can  cause the growth of deposits at the lowest point of the relay interior.  This in turn may increase the relay contact resistance resulting in false  starts or even causing short circuits and possibly a thermal reaction.  In case of a short circuit the possibility of a thermal event cannot be excluded. This may happen while attempting to start the vehicle or while  driving due to vibrations causing a short circuit due to moving deposits.
richiami.rimedio: On the affected vehicles the starter motor will be replaced with a variant  by another supplier with a different design.  Until the repair has been completed it is recommended to not leave the  vehicle running unattended after starting the engine.
richiami.titolo: Replace the Engine Starter Motor

richiami.difetto: The accumulator in the head airbag inflator may not have been manufactured in accordance with specifications. Over time this could cause it to leak. If activated in an accident, the airbag would not fully deploy, as a result of which its restraining effect would be impaired. In addition, irrespective of the airbag being activated in an accident, the accumulator may detach. In this case, the accumulator could enter the interior of the vehicle or become detached from the vehicle. This could lead to an increased risk of injury for passengers and/or passers-by. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown

Inoltre, indipendentemente dall'airbag essere attivato in un incidente, l'accumulatore potrebbe staccarsi. In questo caso, l'accumulatore potrebbe entrare nell'abitacolo del veicolo o staccarsi dal veicolo. Ciò potrebbe comportare un aumento del rischio di lesioni per i passeggeri e/o i passanti. richiami.difetto: A quality check has revealed a potential issue with the steering gear software  program which monitors the function of two sensors and compares the  signals. In the vehicles concerned due to an error in the software the failure  of a sensor may not always be detected correctly. When a failure has been  detected correctly the driver is notified of it by a Check Control message on  the Central Display and minimal change to steering feel.
richiami.rimedio: To ensure your vehicle is in perfect working order we would like to program the vehicles  control units. This work will be free of charge.
richiami.titolo: Programming Control Units (Steering Gear)

richiami.difetto: The seatbelts in the second row may not have been manufactured correctly and could cause the car-sensitivity sensors to fail. This could reduce the protective effect of the seatbelts and lead to injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The seatbelts in the second row may not have been manufactured correctly and could cause the car-sensitivity sensors to fail.

traduzione.difetto: Le cinture di sicurezza della seconda fila potrebbero non essere state prodotte correttamente e potrebbero causare il malfunzionamento dei sensori di sensibilità auto. Ciò potrebbe ridurre l'efficacia protettiva delle cinture di sicurezza e provocare lesioni. Il prodotto non rispetta il Regolamento sull'approvazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

traduzione.titolo: Le cinture di sicurezza della seconda fila potrebbero non essere state prodotte correttamente e potrebbero causare il malfunzionamento dei sensori di sensibili…

richiami.difetto: A quality check has revealed that the affected G61 vehicles software does not  reflect the associated CoC documentation.
richiami.rimedio: To ensure your vehicle is in perfect working order we would like to program the control units to adapt the vehicle's software level to the CoC documents. as soon as possible. Naturally  this work will be free of charge.
richiami.titolo: Program control units (CoC documents)

richiami.difetto: Water may come into contact with the starter relay and gradually cause corrosion. This could affect the electrical connection inside the relay and make the engine difficult to start. It may also result in a short circuit and could cause the starter to overheat leading to a fire when the vehicle is in motion or when it is parked with the ignition off. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: Water may come into contact with the starter relay and gradually cause corrosion.

traduzione.difetto: L'acqua può entrare in contatto con il relè di avviamento e provocare gradualmente corrosione. Ciò potrebbe influenzare la connessione elettrica all'interno del relè e rendere difficoltoso l'avviamento del motore. Potrebbe anche causare un cortocircuito e portare a un surriscaldamento del relè di avviamento, con il rischio di incendi sia mentre il veicolo è in movimento che quando è parcheggiato con la chiave a terra. Il prodotto non risponde alle norme relative all'approvazione e alla sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato la misura(o) notificata: Produttore · Categoria della misura(o): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: Sconosciuta
traduzione.titolo: L'acqua può entrare in contatto con il relè di avviamento e provocare gradualmente corrosione.

richiami.difetto: A defective screw connection between the battery cable and the fuse box in the car boot may become loose. This may result in impaired functioning which can lead to a fire or the engine cutting out during driving which can lead to injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: A defective screw connection between the battery cable and the fuse box in the car boot may become loose.

traduzione.difetto: Una connessione a vite difettosa tra il cavo della batteria e la scatola dei fusibili nel bagagliaio dell'auto può diventare sciolta. Ciò può causare un funzionamento compromesso che può portare a un incendio o al blocco del motore durante la guida, con conseguenze lesive. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sull'approvazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato misura(i) notificata(i): Produttore · Categoria della misura(i): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: Sconosciuta
traduzione.titolo: Una connessione a vite difettosa tra il cavo della batteria e la scatola dei fusibili nel bagagliaio dell'auto può diventare sciolta.

richiami.difetto: The engine starter’s electrical contacts may overheat and cause the vehicle to start improperly. Continued starting attempts can intensify the overheating and  ignite surrounding components, potentially leading to a vehicle fire while driving or shortly after parking. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.modello: X5, X6, X7, 7, 8 (Coupe, Cabrio, Cran Coupe), M340
richiami.omologazione_grezza: G05, G06, G07, G12, G14, G15, G16, G20 (US version) equipped with B58 engine
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The engine starter’s electrical contacts may overheat and cause the vehicle to start improperly.

traduzione.difetto: I contatti elettrici del motore avviatore possono surriscaldarsi e causare l'avviamento improprio del veicolo. Ulteriori tentativi di avviamento possono aggravare il surriscaldamento e provocare l'ignizione dei componenti circostanti, potenzialmente causando un incendio del veicolo durante la guida o poco dopo il parcheggio. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sull'approvazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato misura(i) notificata(e): Produttore · Categoria della misura(i): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: Sconosciuta
traduzione.titolo: I contatti elettrici del motore avviatore possono surriscaldarsi e causare l'avviamento improprio del veicolo.

traduzione.difetto: Le cinture di sicurezza dell'auto non sono state prodotte correttamente. In caso di collisione o incidente, la funzione di contenimento delle cinture di sicurezza potrebbe essere ridotta e non potrebbe fornire la protezione necessaria. Di conseguenza, potrebbe esserci un maggior rischio di lesioni. Il prodotto non rispetta il Regolamento sulla approvazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato misura(i) notificata(i): Produttore · Categoria della misura(i): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: Sconosciuta
traduzione.titolo: Le cinture di sicurezza dell'auto non sono state prodotte correttamente.

richiami.difetto: For affected vehicles local overheating may occur at the electrical contacts of the vehicle's engine starter motor. This may cause an increase in current flow resulting in local overheating or risk of thermal event.
richiami.rimedio: Replacement of the starter motor.
richiami.titolo: Replace the Engine Starter Motor

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the screw connection on the B+ power distributor in the vehicle's boot may have not been properly tightened.
richiami.rimedio: On affected vehicles the connections will be reworked.
richiami.titolo: Screw Connection of the Power Supply

richiami.difetto: For vehicles fitted with a Takata front passenger airbag with a PSPI inflator these vehicles have previously received a like for like replacement front passenger airbag via a previous safety recall campaign.
richiami.rimedio: The front passenger airbag module of the affected vehicles will now be replaced by an airbag module or an inflator that does not contain ammonium nitrate.
richiami.titolo: Replace the Front Passenger Airbag Takata PSPI

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the front seat belts may have damage to the torsion bar caused during manufacture. The retention function of the seat belt may not perform as expected in the event of an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles will have the affected seatbelts replaced.
richiami.titolo: Front Seat Belt Retractor

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the front seat belts may have damage to the torsion bar caused during manufacture. The retention function of the seat belt may not perform as expected in the event of an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles will have the affected seatbelts replaced.

richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles will have the affected seatbelts replaced.

richiami.difetto: Due to a manufacturing failure, the protection of the two outer headrests in the second row is reduced. In the event of a collision or accident, passengers could be injured. In addition, headrest parts may become exposed and also cause serious injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: Due to a manufacturing failure, the protection of the two outer headrests in the second row is reduced.

traduzione.difetto: A causa di un difetto di fabbricazione, la protezione dei due braccioli anteriori della seconda fila è ridotta. In caso di collisione o incidente, i passeggeri potrebbero subire lesioni. Inoltre, parti dei braccioli potrebbero risultare esposte e causare lesioni gravi. Il prodotto non rispetta il Regolamento sulla approvazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

traduzione.titolo: A causa di un difetto di fabbricazione, la protezione dei due braccioli anteriori della seconda fila è ridotta.

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the outer headrests of the second row of seats may not have been  manufactured correctly. In case of a collision or an accident they may not provide the necessary protection increasing the risk of injury.
richiami.rimedio: On the affected vehicles the headrest of the second row seats will be  replaced.
richiami.titolo: Replacing the Head Rest (2nd seat row)

richiami.difetto: For affected vehicles there is concern that a gap in the windshield urethane seal at the right A-pillar was created. Due to the gap water can ingress with possible water contamination of the glove box and carpet area including the Body Domain Control unit (BDC) and power distribution box.
richiami.rimedio: Check bonding of windshield and for water contamination if necessary reseal windscreen and and inspect electrical components replacing if required.
richiami.titolo: Check Windscreen Bonding reworking if necessary

richiami.difetto: Faulty screwing of the ground cable can increase the contact resistance which could lead to heating of the screw connection. Moreover, this can potentially damage the Power Control Unit (PCU), increasing the risk of fire. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: Faulty screwing of the ground cable can increase the contact resistance which could lead to heating of the screw connection.

traduzione.difetto: Una serratura difettosa del cavo di massa può aumentare la resistenza di contatto, che potrebbe portare al riscaldamento della connessione della vite. Inoltre, ciò può danneggiare potenzialmente l'unità di controllo della potenza (PCU), aumentando il rischio di incendio. Il prodotto non rispetta il Regolamento sull'approvazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato la misura(o) notificata: Produttore · Categoria della misura(o): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: Sconosciuta
traduzione.titolo: Una serratura difettosa del cavo di massa può aumentare la resistenza di contatto, che potrebbe portare al riscaldamento della connessione della vite.

richiami.difetto: The cell modules in the vehicles concerned were not produced in accordance with the specifications, which may cause the module frame to fail. This may lead to a shutdown of the high-voltage system and fire.  The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The cell modules in the vehicles concerned were not produced in accordance with the specifications, which may cause the module frame to fail.

traduzione.difetto: I moduli cellulari nei veicoli interessati non sono stati prodotti secondo le specifiche, il che potrebbe causare il fallimento del telaio del modulo. Ciò potrebbe portare a uno spegnimento del sistema ad alta tensione e a un incendio. Il prodotto non rispetta il Regolamento sulla omologazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato la misura(o) notificata: Produttore · Categoria della misura(o): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: Sconosciuta
traduzione.titolo: I moduli cellulari nei veicoli interessati non sono stati prodotti secondo le specifiche, il che potrebbe causare il fallimento del telaio del modulo.

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the battery module frame may have been manufactured using too much force. In conjunction with swelling force of the battery this could lead to failure and a possible thermal event within the vehicles life time.
richiami.rimedio: On affected vehicles the modules will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: Replacing the Cell Module of the High-Voltage Battery

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the battery module frame may have been manufactured using too much force. In conjunction with swelling force of the battery this could lead to failure and a possible thermal event within the vehicles life time.
richiami.rimedio: On affected vehicles the modules will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: Replacing the Cell Module of the High-Voltage Battery

richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles will have the ground connection checked and re-torqued. If required the relevant cable and Power Control Unit will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: Checking the Threaded Connection of Grounding Cable PCU48

richiami.titolo: Checking the Threaded Connection of Grounding Cable PCU48

richiami.difetto: The material used for the B-pillar reinforcement plates is inadequate. This can alter the crash characteristics, leading to an increased risk of injuries in the event of an accident. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The material used for the B-pillar reinforcement plates is inadequate.

Questo può alterare le caratteristiche di impatto, aumentando il rischio di lesioni in caso di incidente. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla approvazione e sul controllo del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

traduzione.titolo: Il materiale utilizzato per le placche di rinforzo del pilastro B è insufficiente.

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the screw connection of the positive battery cable onto the starter generator may not have been performed to specification.
richiami.rimedio: On affected vehicles the starter generator will be replaced and positive cable will be reworked / replaced if required.
richiami.titolo: Rework/Replace the Starter Generator (SGR)

richiami.difetto: The front end may not be correctly bolted to the engine subframe. If one of the bolts has not been properly tightened and becomes detached, vehicle safety may be compromised in the event of a frontal collision. In this event, there may be an increased risk of injury. Moreover, a detached bolt can pose a risk of accident to the following traffic. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The front end may not be correctly bolted to the engine subframe.

traduzione.difetto: Il frontale potrebbe non essere correttamente fissato al telaio motore. Se uno dei bulloni non è stato adeguatamente serrato e si stacca, la sicurezza del veicolo potrebbe essere compromessa in caso di collisione frontale. In tal caso, potrebbe esserci un maggior rischio di lesioni. Inoltre, un bullone staccato può rappresentare un rischio di incidente per il traffico che lo segue. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla omologazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

traduzione.titolo: Il frontale potrebbe non essere correttamente fissato al telaio motore.

richiami.difetto: Damaged brake discs may have been fitted to the front axle. This can lead the brakes to fail when a heavy load is placed on the wheel concerned, increasing the risk of accident and injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: Damaged brake discs may have been fitted to the front axle.

traduzione.difetto: I dischi dei freni anteriori potrebbero essere stati montati danneggiati. Ciò può causare il malfunzionamento dei freni quando viene applicata una grande pressione sul cerchio interessato, aumentando il rischio di incidenti e lesioni. Il prodotto non rispetta il Regolamento sulla approvazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

traduzione.titolo: I dischi dei freni anteriori potrebbero essere stati montati danneggiati.

richiami.difetto: Failure to bolt the plus voltage (B+) cable tightly enough to the starter generator may result in contact problems and an increase in contact resistance at the bolted connection. This may in turn lead to local overheating and the vehicle catching fire or to the engine stalling while the vehicle is coasting. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown

traduzione.difetto: La mancata serratura sufficiente del cavo di tensione positiva (B+) al generatore di avviamento può causare problemi di contatto e un aumento della resistenza di contatto nella connessione bullonata. Ciò potrebbe a sua volta portare a surriscaldamento locale e al rischio di incendio del veicolo o al blocco del motore mentre il veicolo è in marcia a vuoto. Il prodotto non risponde alle disposizioni relative all'approvazione e alla sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

traduzione.titolo: La mancata serratura sufficiente del cavo di tensione positiva (B+) al generatore di avviamento può causare problemi di contatto e un aumento della resistenza…

richiami.difetto: The positive battery cable of the starter-generator may not have been manufactured correctly. This could result in a loose electrical connection, leading to excessive contact resistance. The vehicle cannot charge or start. Contact points in the starter-generator could overheat and cause a vehicle fire. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The positive battery cable of the starter-generator may not have been manufactured correctly.

traduzione.difetto: Il cavo positivo della batteria del generatore di avviamento potrebbe non essere stato prodotto correttamente. Ciò potrebbe causare una connessione elettrica instabile, portando a una resistenza di contatto eccessiva. Il veicolo non può caricarsi né avviarsi. I punti di contatto nel generatore di avviamento potrebbero surriscaldarsi e provocare un incendio nel veicolo. Il prodotto non rispetta il Regolamento sulla omologazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato misura(i) notificata(e): Produttore · Categoria della misura(i): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: Sconosciuta
traduzione.titolo: Il cavo positivo della batteria del generatore di avviamento potrebbe non essere stato prodotto correttamente.

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the rear brake hoses may not have been crimped correctly during production.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles will have the brake hoses replaced.
richiami.titolo: Replace Rear Brake Hose G45

richiami.difetto: During the production process, the wheel axle of the differential gear in the drive unit has been mounted without a circlip. This can result in the wheel axle migrating. There is an acoustic abnormality in the drive unit. This can additionally lead to oil seepage, loss of drive power and/or failure of the parking lock. This increases the risk of accident and injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: During the production process, the wheel axle of the differential gear in the drive unit has been mounted without a circlip.

traduzione.difetto: Nel processo di produzione, l'albero della ruota del differenziale nell'unità motrice è stato montato senza un anello di bloccaggio. Ciò può provocare lo spostamento dell'albero della ruota. Nell'unità motrice si verifica un'anomalia acustica. Ciò può inoltre causare perdite di olio, perdita di potenza motrice e/o malfunzionamento del blocco di parcheggio. Ciò aumenta il rischio di incidenti e lesioni. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sull'approvazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

traduzione.titolo: Nel processo di produzione, l'albero della ruota del differenziale nell'unità motrice è stato montato senza un anello di bloccaggio.

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the 48v connection to the starter generator may not be secured to the correct specification.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles will have the connection checked and reworked if required.
richiami.titolo: Rework Starter Generator Electrical Connection

richiami.difetto: The propellant in the inflator of the driver airbag may deteriorate over time. If the airbags deploy, it could result in fragments of the inflator injuring the vehicle's occupants. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The propellant in the inflator of the driver airbag may deteriorate over time.

traduzione.difetto: Il propellente presente nell'inflatore del airbag del conducente può deteriorarsi nel tempo. Se gli airbag si attivano, potrebbero causare lesioni agli occupanti del veicolo a causa di frammenti dell'inflatore. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla approvazione e sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato misura(i) notificata(i): Produttore · Categoria della misura(i): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: Sconosciuta
traduzione.titolo: Il propellente presente nell'inflatore del airbag del conducente può deteriorarsi nel tempo.

richiami.difetto: Affected vehicles may have a B-Pillar which may have been produced using incorrect materials.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles will have an inspection conducted and if an affected B-Pillar is found it will be replaced with a component of the correct specification.
richiami.titolo: Checking the B-Pillar U11

richiami.difetto: The hollow shaft of the servomotor was not welded correctly. The weld may not be able to withstand high braking pressure build-up and may break. In this case, the reduced braking performance requires greater force and the braking distance may increase. In addition, the ABS and DSC brake control systems are not assisted. This increases the risk of an accident. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.modello: 2series, 5series, i5, 7series, i7, X1, iX1, X2, iX2, X5, X6, X7, XM, X5M, X6M
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The hollow shaft of the servomotor was not welded correctly.

traduzione.difetto: L'asta vuota del servomotore non è stata saldata correttamente. La saldatura potrebbe non essere in grado di resistere alla pressione elevata del freno e potrebbe rompersi. In tal caso, la ridotta performance frenante richiede una maggiore forza e la distanza di frenata potrebbe aumentare. Inoltre, i sistemi di controllo frenante ABS e DSC non sono assistiti. Ciò aumenta il rischio di incidente. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla omologazione e sul controllo del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

traduzione.titolo: L'asta vuota del servomotore non è stata saldata correttamente.

This increases the risk of injury to vehicle occupants. Additionally, the airbag warning light or Check Control message may not activate, leaving the driver unaware of the fault. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

Ciò aumenta il rischio di lesioni per i passeggeri. Inoltre, il segnale di avvertimento airbag o il messaggio Check Control potrebbero non attivarsi, lasciando il conducente ignaro del guasto. Il prodotto non rispetta il Regolamento sulla approvazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

traduzione.difetto: Un difetto di fabbricazione nell'airbag passeggeri può causare perdita di pressione quando viene attivato. richiami.difetto: The affected vehicles may be equipped with a crankshaft sensor with a software fault.  The crankshaft sensor cannot process the signal values from the crankshaft transmitter due to an improper firmware level.  The firmware does not compensate sufficiently the temperature gradients and the magnetic field strength of the sensor electronic.  If the crankshaft sensor cannot process the signal values from the transmitter the Digital Diesel Electronic (DDE) will notice that and change to the emergency operation mode. The emergency mode will be displayed by the check control message �engine malfunction�.  The driver may notice a rough running engine and a reduced driving power (70%). However an engine stalling during driving conditions cannot be excluded.
richiami.rimedio: On the affected vehicles the crankshaft sensor will be replaced with a new version.
richiami.titolo: SOFTWARE FAULT WITH CRANKSHAFT SENSOR

If the crankshaft sensor cannot process the signal values from the transmitter the Digital Diesel Electronic (DDE) will notice that and change to the emergency operation mode. The emergency mode will be displayed by the check control message �engine malfunction�.  The driver may notice a rough running engine and a reduced driving power (70%). However an engine stalling during driving conditions cannot be excluded.
richiami.rimedio: On the affected vehicles the crankshaft sensor will be replaced with a new version.
richiami.titolo: SOFTWARE FAULT WITH CRANKSHAFT SENSOR

richiami.difetto: The ball stud of the left wishbone (control arm) on the front axle is inadequate. As a consequence, it could break and lead to impaired steering.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The ball stud of the left wishbone (control arm) on the front axle is inadequate.

richiami.difetto: The fault affects the brake system in particular the brake calipers on the rear axle. Because of a faulty coating hydrogen gas (approximately 10 ml) could be created in the coating of the piston of the brake caliper.  This will be completely outgassed during the first 2 months after the production process causing longer brake pedal travel.  Under certain circumstances the relevant brake pressure cannot be build up in the rear brake circuit. As a result the brake force of the  system may be reduced by up to 30%.  The driver may feel a soft brake pedal and a reduction of the brake performance. In certain cases the rear brake circuit could fail leading to increased risk of an accident.
richiami.rimedio: On the affected vehicles the brake system will be bled.
richiami.titolo: PISTONS IN REAR BRAKE CALIPERS MAY NOT BE COATED TO SPECIFICATIONS

richiami.difetto: The fault affects the fuel level sensor within the fuel tank.The distance between the sensor and an in-tank fuel line could be too small which could allow the sensor to contact the fuel line and in some cases become stuck.  If the fuel sensor becomes stuck the fuel gauge in the instrument cluster displays a larger amount of fuel than is actually in the tank. Therefore the tank could become empty leading to the engine stalling without prior warning.
richiami.rimedio: On the affected vehicles the fuel line supply unit system will be reworked.
richiami.titolo: DISTANCE BETWEEN SENSOR AND IN-TANK FUEL LINE COULD BE TOO SMALL

richiami.rimedio: On the affected vehicles both swivel bearings will be checked and if necessary replaced with a part produced to specification.

richiami.difetto: Insufficient control of the fuel pump by the engine control unit the fuel pump may stop functioning in certain driving conditions which could lead in individual cases to a drop of the fuel pressure.  When the fuel pressure drops an engine stalling cannot be excluded.
richiami.rimedio: On affected vehicles the engine control unit will be reprogrammed

richiami.difetto: Over time irregularities in the crimp connection in conjunction with relative movements of the tin coated connector at the end of the wiring harness which connects to the tin coated blower regulator pin could lead to frictional corrosion. In combination with very high current flow which would occur which could lead to a temperature increase. As a result the blower regulator wiring could be damaged and could lead to partial contact of individual wire strands. this could result in an irregular current flow further overheating and increase the risk of fire.
richiami.rimedio: The blower regulator wiring harness will be inspected and a new part will be installed.
richiami.titolo: VARIATION TO ELECTRICAL RESISTANCE IN THE BLOWER REGULATOR WIRING HARNESS CONNECTOR

richiami.difetto: The positive battery cable to the front distribution box behind the glove box can become damaged by vibrations and frictional corrosion. This may cause a loss of electrical connection to the distributions box. Symptoms include being  unable to gain entry or start the car but the most common are a flickering instrument panel or uneven engine performance. However if the electrical connection is completely lost this will also affect the operation of the vehicles lighting systems; e.g. sidelights or hazard warning lamps.
richiami.rimedio: On affected vehicles carry out a suitable repair to the battery cable positive cable.
richiami.titolo: PLUG IN CONTACT CABLE MAY MALFUNCTION

richiami.difetto: In case of deployment of the driver airbag module, the gas generator could burst. If the gas generator bursts, metal fragments could pass through the airbag cushion material.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: In case of deployment of the driver airbag module, the gas generator could burst.

richiami.difetto: The driver airbag module may not have been produced to specification. This could lead to excessive pressure building up inside the inflator causing the inflator to rupture resulting in metal fragments passing through the airbag cushion material into the vehicle interior at high speed. This could lead to injury or death of the vehicle occupants.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the driver airbag module.
richiami.titolo: INFLATOR IN DRIVER AIRBAG MODULE MAY NOT BE PRODUCED TO SPECIFICATION

richiami.difetto: The sealing cap of the pressure-limiting valve in the fuel tank delivery module may be damaged. This concern could lead to a reduction in fuel transfer from the left side to the right side of the fuel tank. Therefore it is possible for the engine to stall even though the fuel gauge would show fuel present.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the fuel pressure of the delivery module and the distance of the cap on the pressure-limiting valve. Where necessary the delivery module will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: RESTRICTED FUEL SUPPLY COULD CAUSE ENGINE TO STALL

richiami.difetto: The latching element of the Easy Entry Kit on the driver's seat does not lock correctly into the lower swinging arm. As a result the backrest could fold under heavy load such as in a collision or unsecured load in the rear and harsh braking.
richiami.rimedio: The vehicle that is likely to be affected will be recalled and a new seat mechanism fitted. R/2018/027 refers.

richiami.difetto: Due to a fault in the supplier's production process the bolt on the outer side of the seat mechanism on both front seats might not have been fixed properly. In cases where the bolt loosens the customer would be alerted by noise coming from the seat and a noticeable increase in seat clearance/movement. If this is ignored by the customer the securing bolt on the outer side of the seat might come off. If the securing bolt comes off the seat can move backwards in a rear end crash situation.
richiami.rimedio: The bolt on the seat mechanism will be checked for excessive clearance and if necessary replaced.

richiami.difetto: The engine oil cooler feed pipe may disconnect and leak oil. This may reach the front brakes and affect the braking efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: On affected vehicles replace engine cooler pipe.
richiami.titolo: OIL COOLER MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: The ball head connecting the brake pedal and the master brake cylinder the ball head might not be locked properly into the ball cage. If the driver accidentally pulls up the brake pedal the brake switch would be activated permanently. This will cause: The brake lamps to be illuminated even while driving A Check Control Message would not alert the driver. An engine start or gear selection would be possible without brake actuation. If the driver's door were opened after switching off the engine the gear would not switch automatically to P as designed.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the locking of the ball head on the brake pedal. If necessary the pedal mechanism will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE SWITCH  MAY BE ACTIVATED PERMANENTLY

richiami.difetto: It is possible a recess on the inside of the instrument panel was not machined correctly. The recess is the predetermined break point of the instrument panel when the front passenger airbag is activated. If the milling has not been carried out correctly the proper deployment of the front passenger airbag cannot be ensured.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the milling of the predetermined break point. Where necessary the instrument panel will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG MAYNOT  DEPLOY CORRECTLY

richiami.difetto: The connection sleeves of the engine oil cooler pipes (feed and return) may not have been crimped correctly. This may result in the connection sleeves becoming loose and engine oil suddenly escaping. If the oil gets to the front brake discs the efficiency could be adverely affected.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the connection sleeves for the engine oil cooler pipes. Where necessary replace the pipes.
richiami.titolo: FRONT BRAKE EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the bolt that connects the ground cable from the wiring harness of the Digital Motor Electronics (DME) to the engine block may not have been tightened/torqued to the correct specification. This can result in the engine cutting out or depending on vehicle speed to restart/turn on the engine once the reset has been completed.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required retorque the bolt for the ground cable on the engine block.

The driver may experience a no start condition or in the worst case an engine stall. A warning lamp and error message will display. Steering and brakes will still function.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the in tank fuel pump with a modified version.

richiami.difetto: It is possible that lubricant contamination may result in the high current welding of the bolt for the fuel tank earth strap not being to specification.  This could over time result in the fuel tank leaking.  The driver will become aware of the leak either by the smell or dripping fuel after refuelling.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles and inspect the fuel tank. If necessary replace the fuel tank.

richiami.difetto: For the left hand rear comfort seat the bracket to which the seat belt buckle is mounted may not be correctly positioned. The incorrect positioning causes incorrect welding of the bracket to the seat frame. If a collision occurs the welding for the bracket may weaken / fail leading to increased risk for the passenger in that seat.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the seat frame for the left hand rear comfort seat.

richiami.difetto: The back-rest adjustment mechanism on both front seats may be incorrectly set and display a large amount of play. This can cause the back rest to wobble and in the event of an accident the back rest may inadvertently fold backwards.
richiami.rimedio: On affected vehicles adjust back rests to manufacturer's specifications.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SEAT BACKREST MAY NOT FULLY ENGAGE

richiami.difetto: The emergency spare wheel mounting may gradually loosen due to vibration. If the flange nut loosens completely the emergency spare wheel well with the spare wheel can suddenly separate from the vehicles underbody.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the flange nut on the mounting plate of the emergency spare wheel well.
richiami.titolo: SPARE WHEEL MAY BECOME LOOSE

This will be indicated by a distinct change in engine running.  The orange engine management warning lamp and a check message; On vehicles with N51/N52 engines  this will appear at ignition recycle on N55 engine it will display immediately.
richiami.rimedio: Repalce bolted connection of the VANOS adjustment unit

richiami.difetto: It is possible that vehicles fitted with Automatic Soft-Closure Feature (SCA) rear doors may have an issue with out of tolerance on the SCA mechanism which can result in the deactivation of the child locks when they are activated. This could result in a child unintentionally opening the door and exiting the vehicle. The driver is informed that the rear door is open by a warning on the instrument panel and an acoustic (noise) warning.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles to check the locks and replace them if required.
richiami.titolo: CHILD SAFETY LOCK MAY NOT ACTIVATE

richiami.difetto: It is possible for the lubrication to the vacuum pump to be interrupted because of a nonconformity with the sealing cap fitted to the intake camshaft. The sealing cap may move and prevent lubrication reaching the vacuum pump causing it over a period to seize. The driver will probably note increasing input is necessary to stop the vehicle. Should the vacuum pump fail completely the vehicle can still be braked albeit with increased pressure applied to the foot brake control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the sealing cap of the intake camshaft. If necessary the sealing cap in the camshaft will be secured with a spacer.
richiami.titolo: BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY BE AFFECTED

richiami.difetto: null The universal joint of the drive shaft may break and cause a sudden loss of drive. The rotating drive shaft may also cause damage.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: Type: 6C, Model: 640i Cabrio, EC type approval number: e1*2007/46*0562*
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: null The universal joint of the drive shaft may break and cause a sudden loss of drive.

richiami.difetto: Electronically deployed tow hitch is automatically deployed by button located ion luggage compartment. The pivot uses a mechanical control link which is electrically  adjusted. This  is necessary to prevent a loosening or shaking loose of the end stop during driving. Due to a software error  in the instrument cluster  the driver may not in certain cases get prior warning if the adjustment fails. The consequences of this are that the ball hitch can shake loose from the end stop whilst driving. The control link can break due to the imposed load of the trailer and the hitch can pivot downwards causing loosening/detachment of the trailer and adversely affect the vehicle control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and reprogramme the control unit/instrument cluster.
richiami.titolo: TOWING BALL HITCH MAY DETACH

richiami.difetto: null In the event of an accident with airbag deployment, the passenger front airbag may not deploy correctly. This can lead to an increased risk of injury for the passenger. Additionally, parts of the instrument panel could be thrown into the passenger compartment.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: null In the event of an accident with airbag deployment, the passenger front airbag may not deploy correctly.

richiami.difetto: The defect concerns the front passenger air bag. The skin of certain instrument panels was not correctly scored. In case of accident with air bag deployment the predetermined breaking point will not tear open resulting in the air bag deploying in the instrument panel. This will lead to insufficient restraint effect and possibly release of parts of the air bag system into the passenger compartment.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the instrument panel.
richiami.titolo: FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY

richiami.difetto: Due to a fault with an internal connection within the Fuel Filter Heater (FFH) it is possible that during temperatures below freezing the FFH can remain permanently activated. This will normally cause the FFH to overheat which will result in the inability to start the vehicle due to a flat battery. This can occur even when the ignition is turned off. However in extreme cases it could cause a vehicle fire.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the FFH.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE

richiami.difetto: The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger airbag inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant wafers. Improperly manufactured propellant wafers could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger airbag to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant and the possibility of a fire.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect and where necessary replace the airbag inflator module.
richiami.titolo: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY

richiami.difetto: It is possible that over a period of time the bolt securing the clutch cover/pressure plate may become loose. The drive should be warned of this by the behaviour of the clutch noise from it or inability to select gears. Under certain conditions complete loss of drive could occur which could place the driver and occupant of the vehicle in a prone position.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the clutch bolts.
richiami.titolo: LOSS OF DRIVE

richiami.difetto: Brake performance may be affected as a result of oil contamination of the brake servo. The servo membrane could over a period of time soften and fail causing lower levels of servo assistance for the brakes.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the vacuum hose and fit a non-return valve (oil stop) between the booster and servo. Where necessary the servo and master cylinder will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE POWER ASSISTANCE MAY BE AFFECTED

richiami.difetto: It is possible that the connection between the B+ cable and the Power Distribution Box can become damaged by wear and heat which is caused by high current flow and high contact resistance. Normally this will result in a non-start situation after parking the vehicle. However it is possible that this could in extreme cases occur whilst the vehicle is in motion. The driver should be make aware of the issue by flickering of the instrument cluster (dash) or an engine mis-fire; but if the driver does not then the engine could cut-out without warning.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the cable/connection with a more robust item.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT

richiami.difetto: null Motor oil may leak from the brake vacuum pump into the vacuum hose and from there onto the brake booster. In isolated cases, the motor oil could damage the membrane and affect the power assist braking. This would mean drivers having to depress the brake pedal harder in order to slow down or stop the vehicle. This could lead to a traffic accident.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: X5 4.8i (N62T engine) manufactured between May 2006 and March 2010.

richiami.difetto: It is possible side and rear windows made out of Makrolon (Synthetic Polycarbon Laminate) may become loose due to insufficient adhesion fixing them in place. This will result in a visual and audible warning of the issue to vehicle occupants. If these warnings are ignored it is possible a window could detach from the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace the Makrolon windows with conventional glass windows.
richiami.titolo: REAR WINDOW MAY DETACH

richiami.difetto: The power steering pump drive belt tensioner pulley securing bolt may fail which will lead to the loss of power steering assistance and the necessity for the driver to supply additional input to steering the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the steering pump drive belt tensioner pulley securing bolt with a more robust version.
richiami.titolo: DRIVE MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: The power steering pump drive belt tensioner pulley securing bolt may fail which will lead to the loss of power steering assistance and the necessity for the driver to supply additional input to steering the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the steering pump drive belt tensioner pulley securing bolt with a more robust version.
richiami.titolo: DRIVE MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: In individual cases the oil pump may no longer provide the required oil pressure. This may cause severe engine damage. Additionally the occurrence of critical driving situations cannot be ruled out because the oil pressure may drop suddenly while driving.  The driver will usually notice a drop in the engine oil pressure due to the check control message ''Low oil Pressure''. It is also possible the engine block will be damaged and as a result engine oil may be lost.
richiami.rimedio: The oil pump will be replaced with the correct version.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: The positive battery cable routed from the vehicle battery to the engine bay consists of one cable in the luggage compartment and one cable in the underbody.  Both cable are connected by a screw connection and covered by a plastic cover.  In single cases the plastic cover may have been fitted incorrectly during the vehicle production.  Over time an incorrectly fitted cover could cause the screw connections to come loose leading to an increased resistance also humidity may affect the connection and cause high resistance and drop in current.  This can lead to the vehicle not starting and in extreme cases the connection could over heat leading to the possibility of a fire in the luggage area.
richiami.rimedio: The clips on the battery will be checked the cover replaced and sealed.
richiami.titolo: RISK OF FIRE

richiami.difetto: It is possible that the vehicle has been fitted with 16 inch front brake discs instead of the required 17 inch brake discs.  If this is the case extreme braking could result in the over heating of the brake system and introduce vapour (air) bubbles into the brake fluid.  This could affect the braking performance.
richiami.modello: MINI John Cooper Works , MINI John Cooper Works
richiami.rimedio: Recall all potentially affected vehicles and check the size of the brakes discs on the front axle.  If 16 inch brake discs are found replace these with the correct 17 inch brakes discs and brake pads.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE PERFORMANCE COULD BE AFFECTED

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that defects in a material joint may have resulted during the heat treatment of individual components of the rear axle carrier. This may result in failure of the holders of the links and struts even under normal driving conditions. Should the holder of a link fail whilst the vehicle is in motion the handling characteristics of the vehicle would undergo an unexpected change which could result in an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will be checked and if necessary fitted with a quality assured rear axle carrier.
richiami.titolo: REAR AXLE CARRIER MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: The product poses a risk of injuries because insufficient fastening of the inner control-arm swivels and a too low torque can lead to loosening of swivel-heads and consequently to failure of front wheel steerage.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective action taken by the manufacturer.  · Date of entry into force: Unknown

richiami.difetto: The product poses a risk of injuries because the diameter of the anti-roll bar in the rear axles of these vehicles has been found to be too big. If the driver were to change lane quickly (avoidance manoeuvre) at high speed, this could cause the car to swerve.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: MINI COOPER (model code ML31), MINI COOPER D (model code MN51).
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the importer. · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The product poses a risk of injuries because the diameter of the anti-roll bar in the rear axles of these vehicles has been found to be too big.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the connections for the left and right hand door pressure sensors have been reversed at their connection with the airbag control unit. This would have the effect of delaying the detection of a side impact thus causing the airbag to be deployed too late. It should be noted that the fault would not be indicted by the illumination of the airbag system warning lamp.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the pin assignment of the airbag control unit corrected.
richiami.titolo: DOOR PRESSURE SENSORS MAY DELAY SIDE AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT FOLLOWING AN IMPACT.

richiami.difetto: The Anti - Roll Bar fitted to the rear axle has too large a diameter. Detachment may occur with loss of directional control
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicle and replace Anti - Roll  Bar.
richiami.titolo: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL COULD BE LOST

richiami.difetto: The driver’s seat is equipped with a main seatbelt pretensioner and an additional pretensioner where the seatbelt is fastened. During an accident, the pretensioner of the final fitting is activated shortly after activation of the main pretensioner. In some isolated cases, this impulse may cause the buckle of the seatbelt to open unnecessarily. If this happens, the restraining action of the three-point safety belt is lost.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the importer · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The driver’s seat is equipped with a main seatbelt pretensioner and an additional pretensioner where the seatbelt is fastened.

richiami.difetto: If a brake fluid leak occurs the brake fluid low level warning may be given too late.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the serial number of the brake servo and where necessary replace the cap for the expansion tank which includes the warning switch.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that in the event of a situation which requires activation of the driver's seat belt tensioner. The possibility exists that due to an unfavourable pulse within the seatbelt buckle tensioner mechanism the buckle may open inadvertently.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the relevant electronic control units reprogrammed.
richiami.titolo: DRIVER'S SEAT BELT MAY DE-LATCH

richiami.difetto: This product poses a serious risk of injuries because if a roof rack is used, there is a danger of incorrect fitting and loss of both the rack and load.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: Vehicle type: Mini; EC type approval e1*2001/116*0343*
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the importer · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: This product poses a serious risk of injuries because if a roof rack is used, there is a danger of incorrect fitting and loss of both the rack and load.

richiami.difetto: The control cam of the steering lock may break. This is most likely to occur as the vehicle is started or parked. However the possibility of this occurring whilst the vehicle is in motion cannot be ruled out. In this event the steering lock could engage with the effect that it would no longer be possible to steer the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles check manufacturer of lock and if necessary replace steering lock.
richiami.titolo: STEERING LOCK MAY INADVERTENTLY ENGAGE

richiami.difetto: A temporary fault in the greasing system on the brake servo sealing ring could lead to the sealing ring being subject to wear. In unfavourable conditions the seal may be pressed into the brake servo housing as a consequence of increased friction. The arising leak will cause a hissing sound audible within the vehicle interior with the additional consequence that there may be a risk that loss of brake assistance will ensue.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the brake servo replaced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKING POWER ASSISTANCE

richiami.difetto: The product poses a risk of injury because in high-use vehicles, the oscillation fracture can progress so far as to lead to steering lock cam fracture. This normally happens when the vehicle is started, so it cannot be driven. In exceptional cases, the vehicle can be started and the vibration caused by the subsequent movement can cause the steering lock disk to shift into the lock position, immobilising the steering. Therefore, it cannot be ruled out that a failure occurs while driving, leading to critical situations and accidents.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective action by the producer.  · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The product poses a risk of injury because in high-use vehicles, the oscillation fracture can progress so far as to lead to steering lock cam fracture.

richiami.difetto: In some of the above-mentioned vehicles, the vulcanised connection of the lower rubber mount to the metal sleeve of the rear damper may possibly be insufficient. This can lead to the rubber mount becoming separated from the damper, causing lose of control of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the importer. · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: In some of the above-mentioned vehicles, the vulcanised connection of the lower rubber mount to the metal sleeve of the rear damper may possibly be insufficien…

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the lower rubber mounting on the metal bush of the rear shock absorbers may fail to meet the quality requirement. Dependant on the mileage and operating conditions the rubber mounting may come completely free from the shock absorber. If this occurs the bodywork would no longer be supported above the wheels causing it to come into contact with the wheel concerned. Should this occur the possibility exists that a critical driving condition might occur or even the risk of an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the rear shock absorbers checked and replaced if necessary.
richiami.titolo: REAR SHOCK ABSORBER MOUNTING MAY FAIL

richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace all the tyres
richiami.titolo: REAR TYRE MAY HAVE SUDDEN LOSS OF TYRE PRESSURE

richiami.difetto: Mechanical loads exerted on the back-rest heating element of the front seats when persons enter or exit the vehicle may result in damage to the door side contact line in the back-rest padding. In the event that this causes a break of a contact line the damaged area may overheat to unacceptable levels with the heater switched on. It would then not be possible to rule out the risk of minor burns to the occupants clothes and possibly their skin.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and check condition where necessary fit an additional in-line fuse.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SEAT BACK-REST HEATER MAY OVERHEAT
