richiami.difetto: The rear axle control arms may not have been fitted as intended. In consequence the connections on the control arms concerned may become loose causing unacceptable lateral forces to be applied to the securing bolts. In this situation exact alignment of the wheels can no longer be guaranteed.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the subject control arms checked for correct alignment and if found not to have been fitted as intended they may require to be replaced.
richiami.titolo: CONNECTIONS ON THE CONTROL ARM TO THE REAR AXLE MAY BECOME LOOSE

richiami.difetto: The front seat occupancy detector can fail to detect that a seat is occupied with the result that the front and associated side air bags and seat belt pre-tensioners may fail to operate in the event of a collision.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and carry out full coding of the ECUs reprogramming as necessary.
richiami.titolo: SEAT OCCUPANCY DETECTOR MAY FAIL AND INPACT ON AIRBAG PROTECTION

richiami.difetto: Due to a hardware fault within the digital engine electronic control unit the possibility exists that the unit could fail completely resulting in loss of engine power.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the control unit with a quality assured item.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF INADVERTNENT LOSS OF ENGINE POWER

richiami.difetto: Due to a hardware fault within the digital engine electronic control unit the possibility exists that the unit could fail completely resulting in loss of engine power.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the control unit with a quality assured item.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF INADVERTNENT LOSS OF ENGINE POWER

richiami.difetto: Due to a hardware fault within the digital engine electronic control unit the possibility exists that the unit could fail completely resulting in loss of engine power.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the control unit with a quality assured item.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF INADVERTNENT LOSS OF ENGINE POWER

richiami.difetto: Due to a hardware fault within the digital engine electronic control unit the possibility exists that the unit could fail completely resulting in loss of engine power.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the control unit with a quality assured item.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF INADVERTNENT LOSS OF ENGINE POWER

richiami.difetto: Possibility that the pin operating the master cylinder may have been welded incorrectly. Resulting in the inability (on failure) to de-clutch or engage a gear.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles inspect the subject weld and replace the clutch pedal if the weld is found to be faulty.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF INABILITY TO ENGAGE GEAR OR DECLUTCH

richiami.difetto: Due to a possible manufacturing error the damping element of the Directional Stability Control (DSC) yaw rate sensor could be faulty.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles check the batch number and replace if necessary.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILE FAULT IN THE DSC YAW RATE SENSOR

richiami.difetto: Due to a possible manufacturing error the damping element of the Directional Stability Control (DSC) yaw rate sensor could be faulty.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles check the batch number and replace if necessary.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILE FAULT IN THE DSC YAW RATE SENSOR

richiami.difetto: A possible fault in the microprocessor in the air bag control unit could lead to an uncontrolled setting of the output signals from the control unit immediately after switching on the ignition. In unfavourable conditions this may lead to components of the safety and restraint system being triggered. This fault does not affect the vehicle while the car is being driven.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace and code the air bag control unit.
richiami.titolo: UNINTENTIONAL DEPLOYMENT OF AIRBAG

richiami.difetto: The threaded unions on the pressure lines for the power steering gear may not have been sufficiently tightened and could leak oil. Leaking oil could cause the power steering system to fail and in extreme cases escaping oil could ignite on hot engine components.
richiami.rimedio: Check union bolts for signs of leakage. If leaks are found at either of the unions the steering gear will be replaced. If no leaks are found the union bolts will be checked for correct torque.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE FLUID LEAK FROM POWER STEERING

richiami.difetto: It is possible that the reinforcement ring in the front seat belt tensioner has not been securely crimped onto the belt tensioner's steel cable. This connection could give in the event of a severe collision and could work loose in extreme cases.
richiami.rimedio: Check the production date on both front seat belt tensioners and replace if they fall within the affected production period.
richiami.titolo: SEAT BELT TENSIONERS

richiami.difetto: The securing grommet for the front brake hose onto the suspension strut may become detached.  In this situation it is possible that the hose could rub against the inside of the front tyre causing consequential damage to the hose.  In extreme cases brake fluid could leak causing loss of braking action on the front axle.
richiami.rimedio: The repair will involve fitting a securing clip to the hose and grommet and checking the hose for damage.
richiami.titolo: FRONT BRAKE HOSE COULD RUB ON TYRE

richiami.difetto: Depending on the driver's seat position the locking mechanism of the handbrake lever may fail due to the angle that the lever is operated. This may cause the brake to release even when the car is left unattended
richiami.rimedio: Fit a new improved design handbrake assembly.
richiami.titolo: HANDBRAKE MAY SELF RELEASE

richiami.difetto: The brake pedal mounting shaft may have been incorrectly manufactured.  In this situation the bush may become loose and in very extreme situations the brake pedal can become detached.
richiami.rimedio: Check the brake pedal shaft in the bearing  mount and secure it with a new roll pin.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE PEDAL MAY BECOME DETACHED

richiami.difetto: Due to an ECU software error within the electrical system the fuel pump may operate at an insufficient speed once the fuel tank level has been reduced to less than 30 litres.
richiami.rimedio: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled to have the ECU's reprogrammed with updated software.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY CUT OUT WHILST THE CAR IS BEING DRIVEN

richiami.difetto: Under extreme conditions of use the outer ball joint pins may become loose in the front suspension lower arms. Under extreme conditions detachment could occur.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit modified lower arms.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SUSPENSION OUTER BALL JOINT MAY BECOME DETACHED

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that under extreme conditions the lower front suspension arm mounting bolts may become loose and the arm may detach.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace front axle support with modified type and longer suspension lower arm bolts.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SUSPENSION LOWER ARM MAY DETACH

richiami.difetto: It is possible that the ball bearing in the front suspension strut top mounting may not have been securely fitted. If the weight of the car is taken off of the road wheel for any reason the bearing may became displaced with a risk of personal injury or damage to the suspension.
richiami.rimedio: Replace both front suspension strut mounts.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE DETACHMENT OF BALL BEARING FROM FRONT SUSPENSION STRUT TOP MOUNTING

richiami.difetto: It is possible that the ball bearing in the front suspension strut top mounting may not have been securely fitted. If the weight of the car is taken off of the road wheel for any reason the bearing may became displaced with a risk of personal injury or damage to the suspension.
richiami.rimedio: Replace both front suspension strut mounts.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE DETACHMENT OF BALL BEARING FROM FRONT SUSPENSION STRUT TOP MOUNTING

richiami.difetto: Manufacturing faults and software errors in the electronics of the electric fan could cause these components to be thermally overloaded and destroyed. In isolated cases the overloading could lead to scorching or a fire in the fan.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and check the fan type and build. Replace the fan where necessary.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE COOLING FAN MAY FAIL.

richiami.difetto: Cuts have been observed on isolated Continental tyres fitted to vehicles. The cuts (1-5 cm in length) are of varying severity and can lead to a loss of tyre pressure. This can destroy the tyre if the vehicle continues to be driven.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles examine all tyres and replace any found with cuts in the sidewalls.
richiami.titolo: TYRES MAY HAVE CUTS IN SIDE WALLS.

richiami.difetto: Cuts have been observed on isolated Continental tyres fitted to vehicles. The cuts (1-5 cm in length) are of varying severity and can lead to a loss of tyre pressure. This can destroy the tyre if the vehicle continues to be driven.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles examine all tyres and replace any found with cuts in the sidewalls.
richiami.titolo: TYRES MAY HAVE CUTS IN SIDE WALLS.

richiami.difetto: Due to the long term effects of corrosion the above vehicles are being recalled. The corrosion is an age related problem and this recall action will target the oldest cars first in groups of 15000 to 20000. It is believed that as long as the vehicle has a current MOT and is serviced correctly any possible corrosion problems with the shaft will be highlighted as a matter of course. If customers are concerned they can visit any BMW dealer to have the shaft checked.
richiami.rimedio: DEFECT (cont.) If the component is safe the car will not be repaired at this stage but will be recalled at a later date as originally planned.  REMEDY Recall affected vehicles and fit modified lower steering shaft.
richiami.titolo: LOWER STEERING SHAFT MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the brake light switch circuits may become defective and cause the brake light circuit to fail stay on continuously or flicker. In extreme cases the brake switch could overheat.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace brake light switch with a modified version.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE LIGHTS MAY FAIL TO OPERATE REMAIN ON OR FLICKER

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the brake light switch circuits may become defective and cause the brake light circuit to fail stay on continuously or flicker. In extreme cases the brake switch could overheat.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace brake light switch with a modified version.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE LIGHTS MAY FAIL TO OPERATE REMAIN ON OR FLICKER

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the brake light switch circuits may become defective and cause the brake light circuit to fail stay on continuously or flicker. In extreme cases the brake switch could overheat.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace brake light switch with a modified version.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE LIGHTS MAY FAIL TO OPERATE REMAIN ON OR FLICKER

richiami.difetto: Possibility that the automatic transmission may lock up at speeds below 15mph.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit a new quality assured gearbox.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT GEARBOX MAY LOCK UP

richiami.difetto: Possibility that the automatic transmission may lock up at speeds below 15mph.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit a new quality assured gearbox.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT GEARBOX MAY LOCK UP

richiami.difetto: In certain driving conditions it is possible for the side airbags and the battery terminal (safety isolation switch) to trigger when this is not necessary ie when no accident has occurred.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and recode the airbag control unit.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE UNSCHEDULED DEPLOYMENT OF SIDE AIRBAGS AND ACTIVATION OF BATTERY ISOLATOR SWITCH

richiami.difetto: Instances of corrosion on the corrugated section of the lower steering shaft have occurred. This could lead to eventual weakening of the shaft.
richiami.rimedio: All vehicles fitted with corrugated type lower steering shafts will have them replaced with quality assured examples.
richiami.titolo: CORROSION ON LOWER STEERING SHAFT

richiami.difetto: The three bolts which secure the stub axle to the spring strut may not have been fully torqued on initial assembly.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and check the torque setting on the bolts involved retorqueing as required. Any bolts found to have been loose (as distinct from being insufficiently torqued) will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: SECURITY OF STUB AXLE MOUNTINGS

richiami.difetto: Due to production tolerances at the halfshaft splines the rear wheel bearings may not have been correctly pre-loaded during assembly. This could lead to bearing damage and premature failure.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and check the halfshaft flange connection. Where this is outside prescribed tolerances the halfshaft and roller bearing will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO WHEEL BEARINGS

richiami.difetto: Chafing may occur where two cables pass through a grommet in the front bulkhead. This could result in a short circuit and fire risk.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles. De-energise the 6 sq.mm. battery positive cable which backs up the engine management system by cutting it at both ends and taping it to the cable. An alternative arrangement is being made to back up the engine management system.
